vulkanbufferboost.configuration.title: VulkanBufferBoost Settings
Whether to rewrite the chunk rendering staging buffer size. When disabled, the buffer size is left untouched.
vulkanbufferboost.configuration.sourceSi: The original constant that gets replaced (98 MiB in 26.3). Rarely needs changing. Accepts units such as 98 MiB / 100MB, or raw bytes such as 102760448.
vulkanbufferboost.configuration.targetSi: The buffer size to replace it with. Accepts units such as 128 MiB / 256MB / 1GiB, or raw bytes. In CPU staging mode the single tryAppend limit equals targetSize; in PersistentlyMapped mode the limit equals targetSize / 2. Defaults to 128 MiB. Increase it if crashes persist.
VulkanBufferBoost reads its configuration when the buffer is first rewritten. Fully restart the game for changes to take effect.
